novel_features.name: Top revenue
novel_features.description: Rank founder case studies by monthly revenue parsed from their titles.
novel_features.rationale: StarterStory has no revenue sort; the ranking only exists once titles are parsed into the local index.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Pick this to find the highest-revenue proven case studies without scrolling the site.

novel_features.name: What's new
novel_features.description: Diff the sitemap against your last sync to surface newly published stories, ideas, and businesses.
novel_features.rationale: Requires a prior local snapshot of the sitemap; the site offers no changelog.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Track the StarterStory feed offline between syncs.

novel_features.name: Filtered offline search
novel_features.description: Full-text search the local index with section and minimum-revenue filters (hunt = filtered search).
novel_features.rationale: The on-site search cannot filter by section or revenue; the local FTS index can.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Reach for this instead of the weak on-site search when you need filtered, structured results.

novel_features.name: Idea grep
novel_features.description: Keyword-filter across all indexed idea and story slugs offline.
novel_features.rationale: Scans 5,950 idea slugs locally with regex, which the site cannot do.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Fast local keyword scan across the whole idea corpus.

novel_features.name: Corpus stats
novel_features.description: Counts by section plus the revenue distribution across the case-study corpus.
novel_features.rationale: Aggregates the full local index, which requires having synced it first.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Understand the shape of the StarterStory corpus at a glance.

narrative.headline: Every Starter Story case study, idea, and business indexed locally — rank founder stories by revenue, search 13k+ entries offline, and diff what's new, none of which the site itself can do.
narrative.value_prop: Starter Story has no API and weak on-site filtering. This CLI builds a local SQLite index from the full sitemap so you can rank case studies by monthly revenue (top-revenue), search with section and revenue filters offline (search), and see what's new since your last sync (whats-new).

quickstart.comment: confirm the site is reachable before syncing
build the local index from the sitemap (all sections)

troubleshoots.fix: run 'starterstory-pp-cli index' first to build the local index

troubleshoots.symptom: a story has no revenue in top-revenue
troubleshoots.fix: revenue is parsed heuristically from the title; stories without a $/month title are ranked last

narrative.when_to_use: Use this CLI to research proven, revenue-backed business ideas and founder case studies from Starter Story. It is best for ranking and filtering the corpus offline and for tracking new entries over time.
anti_triggers: Do not use this CLI for premium/paywalled Starter Story playbook content — only public story, idea, and business pages are supported.
Do not use it for live analytics on your own business.
